headline: Uma Reddy C Substantial Acquisition in Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited
sum: Uma Reddy C has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited. The disclosure marks crossing of a regulatory threshold in share ownership, triggering mandatory takeover code compliance.
detail: Uma Reddy C has submitted a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) to NSE regarding Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited. The filing was archived on NSE on 24 June 2026. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure when an acquirer breaches prescribed thresholds (typically 5%) of a listed company's voting capital. The disclosure is the formal notification triggering the acquirer's obligations under Chapter III (open offer) of the Takeover Code.
